subject: general
question: The 1st anniversary of starting of a new Central Sector Scheme, namely, the Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi (PM-KISAN) was in ______.
solution:
The correct answer is __**February 2020.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi (PM-KISAN**) had its 1st anniversary on **24th February 2020.**
 
• The Scheme was **formally launched** on **24th February 2019** by the **PM Narendra Modi** at **Gorakhpur, Uttar Pradesh.**
 
• The scheme was started with a view to augment the income of the farmers by providing income support to all landholding farmers’ families across the country, to enable them to take care of expenses related to agriculture and allied activities as well as domestic needs.
 
• PM Kisan is a **Central Sector Scheme **with **100% funding from the Government of India.**
 
• It is being implemented by the **Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] Important Points__**

 
• Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi:

 
 
• Under this, all farmers will get up to ₹6,000 per year as minimum income support. 
 
• The scheme has cost ₹75,000 crores per annum.
 
• ₹6,000 will be paid every year in three equal instalments of Rs. 2000 each.
 
• The fund of Rs 2,000 is directly transferred to the bank accounts of the farmers/farmer's family.
 
• The scheme defines a family as a husband, wife, and minor children.
 
 

e4:T
